First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @dctriclub the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Weekly Hains Point Rides (DC Tri Club) group ride

Weekly Hains Point Rides (DC Tri Club) is a road and social group ride in Washington, DC. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Hains Point, East Potomac Park.

A weekly Wednesday-evening group meetup at Hains Point. The club meets at 5:45, does intros and clips in at 6:00. The group rides for about an hour, then gathers on the grass for snacks and chat.
